Nina (Docs): Quick heads-up  I'm updating the SOC2 audit-log doc to clarify retention vs cache TTL and include export snippets. Posting draft bits here before opening a PR. Can someone scan for legal/security gotchas?

Sam (Security): Thanks. Please be explicit: "retention period" = how long an audit event is permanently stored in the durable audit store. "cache TTL" = temporary in-memory/prefetch caches that may truncate older entries sooner. Customers can configure retention (subject to contract), caches are best-effort for latency.

Nina (Docs): Draft JSON event example (for engineers):
```json
{
  "event": "session.created",
  "tenant": "org_789",
  "time": "2026-03-22T09:45:12Z",
  "actor": { "id": "svc_ingest", "type": "service" },
  "details": { "user_agent": "redwood/1.2" },
  "retention_period_days": 120
}
```

Priya (Legal): Wording note: in prose call it "default retention period" and avoid "may retain" language. Use: "By default we retain audit events for 120 days unless a different period is specified in the customer's contract or account settings." That keeps us clear.

Ethan (Eng): Implementation note: for high-volume tenants we sample older events on export to limit bandwidth. Exports are best-effort paginated streams; when sampling occurs we include a header in the export manifest describing sampling rate. Also, Dedicated/Private deployments behave differently: Dedicated keeps full persistent logs per contract; Private installs depend on customer retention config.

Nina (Docs): Good. Adding a tiny SDK export example for Go + a curl example for the public API.

Nina (Docs): ```go
// pseudo
client.Audit().Export(ctx, AuditExportParams{
  Tenant: "org_789",
  Since:  "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
})
```

Nina (Docs): curl example:```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export?tenant=org_789&since=2026-01-01"
```

Sam (Security): Add one line about encryption: "Audit logs are encrypted at rest; for accounts configured with customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) we use those keys for zero-trust wrapping. Key rotation is supported; rotation does not retroactively rewrap previously archived blobs without rewrap operation." Link to rotation guide would be great.

Priya (Legal): Also add a sentence about access controls: "Access to audit exports is role-gated and logged; export requests require audit:export permission and are recorded as admin events." That helps SOC2 reviewers.

Ethan (Eng): I'll paste a short internal link for the export manifest format and sampling header: https://github.internal/redwood/inference/internal/export-manifest.md (will swap to public link in PR).

ci-bot: Draft PR queued: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1301 (WIP) by nina/docs :rocket:

Nina (Docs): Thanks everyone  I'll make these edits (change prose to "default retention period", add KMS line, export sampling note, access-control sentence) and push a draft PR in ~15m. Ping me for final signoff.

Sam (Security): I'll review when it's up. If we mention 120 days as default, add that it's tenant-configurable via support/contract and include a link to the retention policy matrix later.

Priya (Legal): Sounds good. I'll check phrasing on the access-control sentence once PR is open.

Nina (Docs): Awesome  thanks all :pray:
